gaps.explanation: The statement (p5) prints Transfers in (out) net per fund: General Fund (54,009), Street 93,994, Debt Service (39,985), so transfers in = 93,994. The Combining Statement - General Fund Departments (pp14-15) prints the General Fund's transfers gross by department: Police 162,390, Fire 39,985, Park 70,822, Sports Complex 45,223, Auditorium 36,030 (in, 354,450) and Administrative (408,459) (out); net (54,009) = the statement's General Fund figure. Detail in = 354,450 + Street 93,994 (p11) = 448,444; 448,444 - 93,994 = 354,450 = the General Fund departments' gross transfers in that the statement nets inside the General Fund column. Nothing missing or duplicated.

Statement (p5) transfers out = General Fund (54,009) + Debt Service (39,985) = 93,994 (net per fund). Detail out = General Fund Administrative department (408,459) (p14, gross) + Debt Service (39,985) (p13) = 448,444. Difference 354,450 = General Fund inter-department transfers (408,459 gross out less 54,009 net = 354,450, matched by the 354,450 departmental transfers in), which the statement nets within the General Fund column. Nothing missing or duplicated.
